_meta.purpose: BD-curated registry of hosts that frequently appear in Gemini grounded sources for D2C category queries. Each entry annotates the merchant audit's `cited_hosts_detailed` block so the report can tell merchants what they're looking at and what to do about it.
_meta.owner: BD team for content; engineering reviews schema only

schema_per_host.type: editorial | retailer | marketplace | video | brand | unclassified
schema_per_host.subtype: review_site | department_store | luxury | mass_market | fashion_marketplace | beauty_retailer | wellness_retailer | regional | review_aggregator | creator_platform | social
schema_per_host.categories: list of merchant categories where this host has notable AI-channel presence
schema_per_host.coverage_note: 1-2 sentences: what this host actually publishes for these categories, why it matters
schema_per_host.outreach_hint: 1 sentence: which lever applies (editorial pitch / wholesale onboarding / creator partnership / etc.)

_meta.added_for_test_merchant_audits: 2026-05-07 — initial seed covering hosts that appeared in merch_efbc46b4619cfbdf sleepwear audit + the broader fashion/beauty/lifestyle review surface.

nymag.com.coverage_note: The Strategist (NYMag's product review vertical) runs frequent category roundups including sleepwear; high AI-channel pickup.
nymag.com.outreach_hint: Pitch The Strategist editorial team — 4-8 week cycle for inclusion in roundups.

nytimes.com.coverage_note: Wirecutter (NYT's reviews vertical) is the most-cited consumer review site; inclusion is the single highest-impact editorial placement.
nytimes.com.outreach_hint: Wirecutter editorial pitch — competitive, multi-month review cycle, requires sample submission.

forbes.com.coverage_note: Forbes Vetted runs lifestyle / loungewear / category 'best of' lists; growing AI-channel pickup in 2025-2026.
forbes.com.outreach_hint: Forbes Vetted editorial pitch via their submission process.

mattressclarity.com.coverage_note: Independent review site. Despite the name, publishes 'Best Pajamas / Best Loungewear' annual roundups in addition to mattress content.
mattressclarity.com.outreach_hint: Editorial pitch — submit product samples + pitch via their tip form.

sleepopolis.com.coverage_note: Sleep-product review site; covers sleepwear / loungewear / pillows / mattresses. Reviews AI-cited for sleep-adjacent queries.

goodhousekeeping.com.coverage_note: Good Housekeeping Institute runs product testing + roundups across most D2C categories.
goodhousekeeping.com.outreach_hint: GH Institute submission — formal product testing process.

realsimple.com.coverage_note: Lifestyle reviews vertical; runs roundups in sleepwear / loungewear / home goods.

buzzfeed.com.coverage_note: BuzzFeed Reviews / Shopping verticals run affiliate-driven roundups; high social pickup but variable AI-channel grounding weight.

thecut.com.coverage_note: NYMag's fashion vertical; runs trend pieces + product features. Editorial bar higher than The Strategist.
thecut.com.outreach_hint: Pitch The Cut fashion editors with a trend angle, not just product.

vogue.com.coverage_note: High-fashion editorial; product mentions skew luxury/premium D2C. AI-channel grounded for trend + lifestyle queries.
vogue.com.outreach_hint: Pitch Vogue editorial team via PR / agency relationships.

voguescandinavia.com.coverage_note: Vogue Scandinavia regional edition; frequently cited in K-beauty + Scandi-fashion grounded queries.

harpersbazaar.com.coverage_note: Fashion + lifestyle editorial; mid-luxury angle. Runs sleepwear / loungewear features.
harpersbazaar.com.outreach_hint: Editorial pitch via PR; sample submission.

elle.com.coverage_note: Fashion editorial with shopping vertical; covers loungewear / sleepwear roundups seasonally.
elle.com.outreach_hint: Editorial pitch — shopping vertical receives PR submissions.

glamour.com.coverage_note: Beauty + lifestyle reviews; affiliate-driven product roundups.

allure.com.coverage_note: Beauty-only editorial; Best of Beauty awards are highly weighted in grounded retrieval.
allure.com.outreach_hint: Best of Beauty submission process — annual cycle.

byrdie.com.coverage_note: Beauty + wellness editorial; affiliate roundups + ingredient explainers.

whowhatwear.com.coverage_note: Fashion-trend-driven editorial; affiliate roundups. AI-cited on trend queries.

popsugar.com.coverage_note: Affiliate-heavy lifestyle reviews; high volume of category roundups.

amazon.com.coverage_note: Largest US marketplace; AI-channel grounded for almost every D2C category. Listings + reviews surface heavily.
amazon.com.outreach_hint: Wholesale onboarding via Amazon Vendor Central or 3P seller via Seller Central.

nordstrom.com.coverage_note: Major US department store with strong AI-channel grounded presence in fashion/lifestyle queries.
nordstrom.com.outreach_hint: Wholesale onboarding via Nordstrom Vendor Portal.

macys.com.coverage_note: Mid-market US department store; sleepwear + loungewear category strong AI-channel grounding.
macys.com.outreach_hint: Wholesale onboarding via Macy's vendor portal.

bloomingdales.com.coverage_note: Mid-luxury department store; covers contemporary D2C brands.
bloomingdales.com.outreach_hint: Wholesale onboarding via Bloomingdale's vendor relations.

saksfifthavenue.com.coverage_note: Luxury department store; fashion + beauty premium tier.

neimanmarcus.com.outreach_hint: Luxury wholesale — Neiman Marcus vendor outreach.

target.com.coverage_note: Mass-market US retailer; A-Beauty / D2C-collab heavy in beauty + lifestyle.
target.com.outreach_hint: Target vendor onboarding (note: prefers established brands at scale).

walmart.com.coverage_note: Largest US mass-market retailer; growing D2C presence via Walmart+ + marketplace.
walmart.com.outreach_hint: Walmart Marketplace onboarding (3P) or Walmart vendor (1P).

net-a-porter.com.coverage_note: Luxury fashion marketplace; sleepwear + loungewear premium tier.

revolve.com.coverage_note: Influencer-driven fashion marketplace; high social pickup.

sephora.com.coverage_note: Largest beauty specialty retailer; AI-channel grounded for nearly every beauty query.
sephora.com.outreach_hint: Sephora Accelerate program (D2C/indie brands) or wholesale via vendor relations.

ulta.com.coverage_note: Mass + premium beauty retailer; strong AI-channel grounding for beauty.

iherb.com.coverage_note: Wellness + supplements + K-beauty; strong international AI-channel grounding.

boscovs.com.coverage_note: Regional US (East Coast) department store; sleepwear + home categories.

youtube.com.coverage_note: Product hauls + reviews from mid-tier creators (10k-100k subs) frequently surface in grounded answers.
youtube.com.outreach_hint: Creator partnerships — sponsor 2-3 mid-tier reviewers in your category.

tiktok.com.coverage_note: Short-form viral product content; less stable AI-channel grounding than YouTube but growing.

instagram.com.coverage_note: Visual product discovery; AI-channel grounding weight low compared to editorial.

etsy.com.coverage_note: Handmade / small-batch marketplace; AI-channel grounded for niche / artisanal queries.

ebay.com.outreach_hint: Generally lower-priority for D2C brand authority — confirm market fit.

thewinners.ae.outreach_hint: Regional / international wholesale — confirm market relevance before pursuing.

oliveyoungglobal.com.coverage_note: K-beauty specialty retailer (international); high AI-channel grounding for K-beauty queries.
oliveyoungglobal.com.outreach_hint: K-beauty wholesale — Olive Young vendor relations.

skinsort.com.coverage_note: Skincare ingredient + product database; aggregates reviews + ingredient analysis.
skinsort.com.outreach_hint: Skinsort listing — submission via their database curation process.
